# Set Up Next.js Dashboard App

> Create and run a new Next.js dashboard application using a starter example. This setup includes exploring the folder structure and preparing for development.

**Generated by [BuildBridge](https://github.com/researchsite)**

## Prerequisites

- **pnpm**: `npm install -g pnpm`

## Steps

### 1. Open terminal and change directory
```bash
cd <your-preferred-folder>
```
> Replace <your-preferred-folder> with the folder where you want to create the project.

### 2. Create a Next.js application using the starter example
```bash
npx create-next-app@latest nextjs-dashboard --example "https://github.com/vercel/next-learn/tree/main/dashboard/starter-example" --use-pnpm
```
> This installs Next.js with a pre-configured example.

### 3. Navigate into the project directory
```bash
cd nextjs-dashboard
```
> You will now be in your new Next.js project folder.

### 4. Install project packages
```bash
pnpm i
```
> This command installs all dependencies listed in the project's package file.

### 5. Start the development server
```bash
pnpm dev
```
> This will launch the Next.js development server on port 3000.

### 6. Open your web browser and check the application
```bash
http://localhost:3000
```
> Your home page should display the default unstyled layout, confirming successful setup.

## Stack

- Next.js
- TypeScript

## Estimate

~30 minutes | **beginner**
